versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Fen lights that make enemy attacks go Astray and hit their own side, with dodging Flit units and empty board slots as a resource.
Wins come from Drowned payoffs, decoy Marsh Lights and growth along the gaps.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Settled the self-hit rules: an already-Astray attack lands where it hits, Flit dodges only enemy attacks, and a Marsh Light hit by its own side Drowns. Follette now clearly adds a Flit use rather than granting Flit.
Foxfire grows each Wisp per adjacent gap and Glim feeds Wisps next to gaps, so the fen build gets a late growth curve.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
